verdict.rationale: Attio's homepage includes an example exchange stating existing deal history will be 'mapped during onboarding' with a migration checklist. Its REST API and App SDK let records be written programmatically, and object actions are suggested for 'imports, syncs'. This points to migration being possible via onboarding help or custom API/app work rather than a documented CRM-to-CRM importer. Missing for 10: a documented native import or migration tool from other CRMs, explicit preservation of record owners, documented carry-over of activity/interaction history, and independent or hands-on corroboration of migration fidelity.
